why: The closed boundary around explicit Kagent v0.10.2 create support. scoped_support names the only production, test, bundle-fixture, current-doc, and CI-workflow files that may use approved Kagent vocabulary; scripts/check-legacy-runtime.py independently pins the same paths and the exact rule classes they waive. Non-waivable operation rules also scan bounded multiline compounds, while exact historical, teardown, refusal, absence, and external test-fixture exemptions remain original physical lines. A stale line, widened path, widened rule, or widened compound window is a failure.

scoped_support.why: These paths may waive only bare-name, API group, v1alpha2, ModelConfig/RemoteMCPServer, official-image, and create-selector findings.
